items.title: A playable NES inside Qwen weights
items.oneliner: Clone a 1GB repo that compiles a 6502 emulator into Qwen and runs NES games in your terminal.

items.title: An inference server for bulk decisions
items.oneliner: OpenAI-compatible server scores many labels from one read, built for high-throughput classification on a single 24GB GPU.

items.title: A native workspace app for agents
items.oneliner: Desktop app organizes terminals and coding agents into panes and workspaces, with installers for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

items.title: A Rust panic path analyzer
items.oneliner: This call graph tool extracts MIR to surface which Rust functions can panic before they hit production.

items.title: Procedural flowers generated in LaTeX
items.oneliner: Lua-powered LaTeX package draws randomized floral margins directly in PDFs, with no external images or vector assets.

items.title: An SVG figure pack for interfaces
items.oneliner: Dependency-free library ships 33 isometric SVG line figures you can drop into React or any frontend stack.

items.title: Open weights for a trillion-parameter model
items.oneliner: Downloadable Mistral weights let teams run a trillion-parameter model on their own infrastructure instead of an API.

items.title: A practical Windows batch file fix
items.oneliner: Short walkthrough explains why apps fail from batch files and shows the pushd fix for current-directory bugs.

items.title: An open source text-to-CAD tool
items.oneliner: Free platform connects coding agents like Codex and Claude Code to generate physical product designs from text.

items.title: A compact local speech recognition model
items.oneliner: This 164MB speech model runs locally on CPU and posts 5.21% WER on English transcription tests.
